Ravi (PM): Kickoff: planning a regulated-banking dedicated beta. Goal = 6 bank partners, 12-week preview, focus: secure on-prem install + data retention guarantees. Need owners: outreach, compliance signoff, install ops.
Clara (Solutions): I can run outreach and intake for NA partners. Will prep an intake sheet capturing legal POC, network constraints, and contract lead time.
Tara (Compliance): Key requirements: SOC2 + PCI mention, explicit no-logging default, restricted telemetry, and documented data flow diagrams. Customers must approve a runbook for emergency debug and sign an opt-in for any logs.
Omar (Infra): Install constraints: air-gapped optional; if not air-gapped we require private VPN or peered VPC. Installer should include SHA256 checksum, systemd unit, and a preflight that verifies GPU, driver, and kernel. Estimate 4 hours per install with a 1-hr follow-up.
Nikhil (Research): Feedback plan: weekly 30m syncs month 1 then biweekly. Provide 8 canonical prompts + precision/recall-ish metrics per workload. Request a short free-text "top 3 blockers" doc at week 4 and week 12.
Ravi (PM): Graduation criteria idea: 1) >=4 integration score for 5/6 customers; 2) <=1 P0 infra incident; 3) aggregate usage >=8k tokens/day; 4) signed pilot expansion with at least 2 partners. Thoughts?
Tara (Compliance): Add mandatory tabletop for incident response before install. Also retention cap: default 0 days for request logs; if customer opts-in, max 30 days and needs appendix.
Clara (Solutions): Outreach timeline: email cadences next two days, onboard first 2 in 3 weeks, full cohort by end of quarter. I'll attach templates and consent language.
Omar (Infra): Preflight snippet to run on customer host:
```bash
# smoke test
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || exit 1
python3 -c "import sys; print('ok')"
```
Ravi (PM): Legal notes: Diego will review DPA appendix. legalbot: please attach our standard regulated preview clause.
legalbot: Attached: reg_preview_clause_v2 (see docs). :robot_face:
Nikhil (Research): Action items: create eval harness (local runner) and dashboard templates for weekly summaries.
Omar (Infra): Action items: installer artifact + runbook PR by Tue, install day template, rollback criteria (auto-fallback to hosted if median latency >2x baseline for 48h).
Tara (Compliance): I'll draft the compliance checklist and tabletop script; share by Wed EOD.
Ravi (PM): I'll draft the preview contract and scoring rubric, aim to circulate Thu 9am PST. Thanks team — please flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
